(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.studio-left-rail,.studio-right-rail'))throw Error('Empty Drawings retains sidebar clutter');if(document.querySelector('.workspace-central-content').innerText.includes('Sheet register'))throw Error('Empty sheet register remains');if(document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-central-content button').length!==1)throw Error('More than one empty action');if(document.querySelector('.workspace-diagnostics [role="tablist"]'))throw Error('Diagnostics tabs visible when collapsed');return {emptyActions:1,sidebars:0,diagnosticsCollapsed:true}})()

(()=>{const input=document.querySelector('input[type="file"][accept*=".dxf"]');const transfer=new DataTransfer();transfer.items.add(new File(["<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"800\" height=\"600\" viewBox=\"0 0 800 600\"><rect width=\"800\" height=\"600\" fill=\"white\"/><rect x=\"80\" y=\"80\" width=\"640\" height=\"420\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"black\" stroke-width=\"4\"/><text x=\"100\" y=\"140\" font-size=\"30\">Navigation test drawing</text></svg>"],'navigation-test.svg',{type:'image/svg+xml'}));input.files=transfer.files;input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.studio-right-rail'))throw Error('Readiness returned to Drawings');if(document.querySelector('.studio-left-rail')?.innerText.includes('Models')||document.querySelector('.studio-left-rail')?.innerText.includes('Evidence layers'))throw Error('Unrelated drawing controls remain');return {drawingLoaded:true,sheetControls:document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label^="Open source page"]').length}})()
